verdict.rationale: Figma ships multiple official SDKs/APIs for AI-native workflows: REST API, Plugin API, Code Connect CLI, and an official MCP server (both local and hosted, confirmed live via runtime probe with proper OAuth flow). Docs are extensive and first-party, with a working llms.txt and confirmed keyless CLI execution. missing for 10: independent third-party developer case studies building production integrations against these SDKs, and a discoverable OpenAPI spec (probe found only 404s for openapi.json variants).
